desc: When Eastern wisdom of 'universal resonance' meets modern mitochondrial science. Here, resonance is not merely a physical phenomenon — it is the underlying logic of life's rhythms. Clinical data are not just numbers — they are the authentic trajectory of cellular self-repair. We decode the scientific stories behind every product, tracing each mechanism design to its origin. All articles include complete references (DOI/PMID), with key conclusions linked directly to original experimental data. No invented concepts — only verifiable scientific narratives.
